description: This file defines the ValueValidator class used within the JSON API filters validators for SuiteCRM. It checks whether input string values contain any banned reserved characters, preventing invalid or potentially harmful input.

classes.name: ValueValidator
classes.description: A validator class that checks if a string value contains any reserved characters and throws an exception if the input is not a string.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the provided value is a string without any reserved characters. Throws InvalidArgumentException if the value is not a string.
